explicit_validation.explanation: The paper uses both LLM-as-a-judge (Claude-3) and human evaluation (participant surveys), but these evaluate different aspects and there is no direct comparison or validation between LLM judgments and human evaluations

prompts.notes: The paper mentions using Claude-3 to 'rate the degree to which LLMs' responses support Biden or Trump on a -1 (Biden) to 1 (Trump) continuous scale' but does not provide the exact prompt text

guidelines.notes: Appendix provides full survey questions including political leaning allocation (0-100% Biden/Trump), candidate favorability ratings, and conversation quality ratings, but no specific scoring rubric for human evaluators beyond the survey questions

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM-as-a-judge (Claude-3) was used to score political leaning in LLM-generated conversation texts, while human evaluation focused on measuring participants' actual political stance changes through surveys. There is no overlap in what they evaluated.
